prompt: Image 1 is one of our finished point-and-click adventure game backgrounds, placed on a larger 16:9 canvas; the flat grey areas (along the right edge and along the bottom edge) are empty canvas. Paint ONLY those grey areas so the picture continues seamlessly: along the right edge continue the autumn park: the lawn with fallen leaves, the wooden swing set, orange and yellow autumn trees, the sky, and the grey paved forecourt in front of it; along the bottom edge continue the same grey square-slab forecourt paving as one wide, continuous, flat and completely empty surface with long soft shadows and a few fallen yellow leaves, down to the bottom edge. Nothing stands on the new paving: no tables, bins, benches, plants, signs, bags or tape. Keep the painted part of image 1 exactly as it is - same positions, sizes, colours and details; do not move, rescale, redraw or crop anything that is already painted. No people, no animals, no cars, no text, no logos, no frames or borders. Image 2 is another background from the same game: match its painting technique and keep the brushwork, palette and light of image 1. Style: classic 1990s hand-painted adventure game background. Rich painterly brushwork, slightly exaggerated cartoon proportions with gently curved lines, warm late-afternoon sunlight, saturated but harmonious colours, soft dappled shadows under the trees.
parent_prompt: Image 1 is one of our finished point-and-click adventure game backgrounds. Make exactly this local change: Remove all readable lettering in this part of the picture: on the light-blue box of face masks on the right table paint only a small simple picture of a face mask and no words at all; on the clipboard hanging on the wooden post replace the heading and all lines by loose illegible pencil scribbles (no letters); on the small label of the cardboard box on the left table only a short scribble, no digits. Keep the paper bags, the yellow-and-black tape stripes, the thermos, the posts, the wall and the floor exactly as they are. Change nothing else: keep every other object, the camera, the composition, all positions, sizes, colours and the light exactly as in image 1. No people, no animals, no text, no logos, no frames. Image 2 is another background from the same game: keep the same painting technique. Style: classic 1990s hand-painted adventure game background. Rich painterly brushwork, slightly exaggerated cartoon proportions with gently curved lines, warm late-afternoon sunlight, saturated but harmonious colours, soft dappled shadows under the trees.
